result.reason: The operative language reaches neither the preferred nor fallback position. It does not restrict Licensor/Vendor assignments, require Customer consent, or prohibit assignment to a Customer competitor. Section (c) continues to prohibit Licensee assignments without consent, including affiliate assignments that are not Changes of Control, creating a conflict with subsection (a). The obsolete deemed-reasonable consent language and incorrect cross-reference remain despite the margin comment. Subsection (a) is also grammatically defective ('provided the assignee agrees... to the consummation'). The edits are confined to the relevant topic and do not alter unrelated commercial terms, but the margin comment cannot cure the deficient operative language.
